name: tracker-guard
description: Blocks adding analytics and tracking SDKs that haven't been approved.

approved.title: Approved trackers
approved.description: Comma-separated trackers that may be added: a name from the list in the README (mixpanel, posthog, google-analytics ...) or a package name (@segment/analytics-next).

allowWord.title: Approval word
allowWord.description: When your latest prompt contains this word, trackers may be added for that prompt. Leave empty to rely on the approved list alone.

blockErrorTracking.title: Also block error tracking
blockErrorTracking.description: Sentry, Bugsnag and Rollbar are allowed by default. Turn this on to treat them like analytics.
